verdict.rationale: v0 has no documented 'automations' feature. Its GitHub integration does provide versioning and review for the code it generates: isolated branches, commits, pull requests, CI checks, preview deployments and Duplicate Branch. That applies only indirectly to anything automation-like v0 builds, and explicit rollback is not documented. Missing for 10: a first-class automation object to version, an explicit rollback/revert capability, review tooling specific to automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
